core.title: 4-1/2 x 4-1/2 Solid Brass Butt Hinge, BOM-5001-450-605

text.description_html:
Bommer 5001-450 4-1/2" x 4-1/2" Solid Brass Door Hinge

Standard plain bearing 4-1/2" door hinge. Medium duty door hinge, standard .134" thickness. Standard full mortise hinge with 5 knuckle design and button tips. BHMA certified architectural grade hinges. Made in the USA.

Specifications: for Bommer 5000-450 Hinge

  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • Thickness: 0.134"
  • Hinge Material: Brass
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • BHMA Certified Hinge
  • Non-Handed
  • Non-Rising Removable Pin
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Full Mortise - Conforms to ANSI A8133 Hinges
  • Polished Brass Finish

Package with matching finish machine screws and wood screws. For use with both metal and wood doors.

*Sold Individually (1 door hinge)
